recommendations.speaker: Johan
recommendations.reasoning: Elekta has been a pandemic loser when hospitals focused on covid, then faced tough times with rising costs. Despite missing downward revised expectations, the stock is up slightly. If you trust the forecasts, a significant improvement is priced in for next year. Valuation looks attractive at current levels around 60 SEK, down from over 100 SEK. Worth a chance for a potential turnaround.
recommendations.quote: Jag kan nog tycka att det rimligtvis borde kunna släppa snart för Elekta som varit en panemi förlorare när sjukhusen riktade allt fokus mot covid och sen då haft det tufft efter det med stigande kostnader. Mycket möjligt att det kan vända här och att Elekta är värd en liten chansning på de här nivåerna.

recommendations.speaker: John

recommendations.speaker: John

För prissöjningarna som du sa, det tar lång tid att få ut prissöjningar i detaljhandeln. Det kan ju ofta vara upp mot ett halvår, ett år kanske för att rulla ut det här till butikerna. Och det börjar ju kicka igång snart och samtidigt så har ju många insatsvaror gått ner istället och dollarn har gått ner. Så det skulle kunna bli lite tvärtom.

Valuation looks attractive if forecasts are correct, with a significant improvement expected next fiscal year. Worth considering at current levels around 60 SEK.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Midzona is conducting a new rights issue to raise 600 million SEK. The prospectus shows how extremely poorly managed the company has been by Spena. The Scandinavian part is doing well, but everything outside Sweden that was quickly acquired has been a disaster. Should probably consider selling everything outside the Nordics. However, positive things ahead: price hikes will kick in, dollar has dropped from top, large savings program will start making a difference. Rights issue broken from day one. Stena guarantees the whole issue. For new shareholders coming in now, no overhang scenario.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Boozt has doubled since end of September and is trading over 110 SEK. Yesterday got an extra boost after announcing strong pressure and record sales in November during Black week. Surprising given reports of weaker Black Friday/Black week sales overall - Svea Ekonomi reported Black week down 9.5% and Black Friday down 12%. Boozt says inventory position is strong and sell-through of fall/winter collection is higher than last year. Aiming for upper end of guidance: up to 15% growth and adjusted EBITDA around 285 million SEK. If caught this rally, might be time to take profits. Trading at very high valuation with 2 SEK profit per share at 110+ SEK price. Even Boozt customers will be forced to cut back on clothing in 2023. Skeptical of the rally.

quotes.text: Jag är skeptisk till boost här. Aktien en bit över 100 lappen, 110, 111 kanske. På den nivån så är det ju väldigt mycket tillväxt under lång tid som är inprisad.

Och då finns det en risk att det blir ett ganska tufft 2023 även för boost, oavsett om de gör det fortsatt jättebra.

bear_case: Very high valuation (~55x P/E)

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Sinis reported first quarterly report, a new listed company making artificial fertilizer from battery waste. Having problems already - delays in construction. Main thesis was extremely cheap electricity in northern Sweden, but this has completely changed in recent weeks. Electricity price in northern Sweden is now almost as high as rest of country - today 425 öre/kWh. Many have been doing the arbitrage with much cheaper electricity in the north. When steel companies start melting iron on electricity like H2GS and SSAB, won't use less electricity. Arbitrage that no longer exists. Risk increased significantly in just a few months. Staying away.

quotes.speaker: Johan
quotes.text: Jag skulle säga att oavsett vad Sinis själva säger så tycker jag att risken har ökat rätt rejält i det här caset nu på bara några månader och jag känner att den här skrivbordsprodukten är något jag inte är, ja men jag håller mig borta från det.

quotes.speaker: Johan

Many companies trying to exploit the arbitrage
Future electricity demand from steel companies (H2GS, SSAB) will keep prices high

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Dustin has fallen 25% in three months while market has been strong, despite being a favorite among managers and analysts. Smells like buying opportunity. The decline came after Dustin cut dividend - decision made after the quarterly report but lowered the stock significantly. Dustin has been a good payer previously but now wants to reduce debt. Could signal weaker demand than expected, or just responsible corporate behavior. Dividend holders, funds and foundations often sell when dividend is cut. In Sweden/Europe more flexible with dividends than US. Might be interesting buying opportunity. In about six months, you'll own a financially more stable company that's not over-leveraged. For someone willing to wait, Dustin could be worth buying.

Så att för den som orkar vänta lite grann tror jag att Dustin kan vara köpvärt.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Shells reported Q3 about 2-3 weeks ago. Has different customers than Dustin - more B2B focused. Has done well by changing product mix to larger share of private labels, helping parry currency and inflation headwinds. One of few actors continuing to net-open new stores - opened ten this year. Collaboration with SkiStar where Shells Express will enter several hotels and stores. Did similar with Circle K and gas stations. Working on new initiatives. Stock down 40% this year. Doesn't look obviously cheap, especially if earnings might decline next year. High debt is negative. Downside probably limited. For long-term investors who like the business, could start buying, but might be better to wait.

insights.quote: Det är väl kanske en av de mest överskattade sakerna av allt inom hela finans. Ofta hör man ju fonder, förvaltare berätta hur många fondbesök de gör och är väldigt stolta över det. Men är det någon gång man någonsin träffat förvaltare som är helt överlägsna för att de har träffat så många bolag? Kollat in fonder som pratat väldigt mycket om hur många bolag de träffar och ändå är de ner helt otroliga 37 procent i år.

summary: Börspodden discusses a range of Swedish stocks with Johan expressing bearish sentiment overall about the market being in denial phase before expected downturn. Key recommendations include buying Raysearch, Midzona, Volvo, and Dustin at current levels; watching Elekta and Shells & Company; but avoiding Boozt and Sinis due to valuation concerns and changed investment thesis respectively. Discussion also covers criticism of Riksbank's Ingves and the FIRE movement's extreme frugality.
key_takeaways: Johan is bearish on overall market expecting downturn as reality of higher rates and activity slowdown hits
Raysearch showing signs of harvest phase with strong order book and improving cash flow
Boozt trading at very high valuation (~55x P/E) with risks of consumer spending weakness in 2023
Sinis investment thesis broken as electricity in northern Sweden no longer cheap
Company visits are overrated according to Johan - don't guarantee better performance
